notes.title: A refreshed identity
notes.detail: Kinetiq now has its own visual identity and app icon.

notes.title: Five main destinations
notes.detail: Home, Discover, Library, Modules and Profile form the foundation of the app.

notes.title: Refined animations
notes.detail: Navigation and interface transitions have received a visual polish.

notes.title: Appearance settings
notes.detail: The settings area provides access to app appearance and version information.

notes.title: Full-screen video player
notes.detail: The player now gives your video the entire screen, with controls layered above it instead of taking up permanent layout space.

notes.title: Floating player controls
notes.detail: Playback, audio, subtitle and other options open as translucent overlays while the video remains visible behind them.

notes.title: Tap to reveal or hide
notes.detail: Tap the video to show or hide the player interface. Controls also fade away automatically during playback and remain available while paused.

notes.title: Improved playback experience
notes.detail: The updated layout makes better use of the display while keeping essential playback actions close at hand.
